cases.description: Verify that getId() returns the identifier that was supplied to the JsonSchema instance during construction (non‑null id).
Verify that getId() returns null when the JsonSchema instance was created without an identifier (id field is null).
Verify that getId() returns an empty string when the JsonSchema instance is created with an empty identifier.
Verify that getId() returns a string consisting only of whitespace characters when the identifier is set to spaces.
Verify that getId() returns the exact identifier containing URL‑encoded characters without performing any decoding.
Verify that getId() correctly returns an identifier that includes a fragment component.
Verify that getId() returns a Unicode identifier (Cyrillic characters) unchanged.
Verify that getId() returns an identifier containing newline characters exactly as supplied.
